title: 3.4.17 Lab: Fix a Broken Arrow
description: A two-parameter arrow function was written without the parentheses around its parameters, so the line will not parse. Fix it. Auto-graded.

steps.title: Run the broken code
steps.instructions: Run the starter. The line where the arrow is defined throws a syntax error before anything else runs.

steps.title: Find what is missing
steps.instructions: The arrow has two parameters but no parentheses around them. Parentheses are optional for exactly one parameter — they become required the moment a second one appears.

steps.title: Fix the parameter list and run it
steps.instructions: Put parentheses around the two parameters, leaving the arrow body unchanged. Run it and confirm the call prints the product of the two arguments.

requirements.title: Parameters wrapped in parentheses
requirements.description: An arrow function is written with parentheses around its parameter list

requirements.title: Two parameters inside the parentheses
requirements.description: The parenthesised parameter list holds two comma-separated parameters
